retainedReference.title: Saint Isaac cathedral, five domes and four porticos

pictures.author: Wolfgang Moroder
pictures.observed: Actually inspected1280px southern facade: gray-beige masonry, broad pediment with bronze relief, eight rose-granite front columns and dark Corinthian caps, recessed arched doors, high central colonnaded drum/clerestory, ribbed gold dome/lantern/cross and two visible smaller open belfries/gold domes. Bronze roof sculpture/relief and inscription are abstracted or omitted; vegetation/crowds remain context.

pictures.author: GraceKelly
pictures.observed: Actually inspected1280px dome detail: large hemispherical gilded shell with raised meridian ribs, dark cornice, short pale window band/bronze figures and balustrade, octagonal lantern with arched dark openings, small gilded cap/orb/cross. No copied pixels, figures, reliefs or lettering.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Saint Isaac cathedral principal exterior: mapped central body/four corner pylons, four granite-columned pediment porticos with two column rows, real primary recessed arched doorway/threshold, colonnaded drum/clerestory, ribbed gilded main dome/lantern/cross and four open belfries/smaller gilded domes. Shared pale limestone, rose granite, painted-metal gold substitute, patinated copper and opaque glazing. Preserve all independent buildings and original roads/water. Historic sculpture, lettering, interior/operating religious fixtures and exact reliefs are omitted or abstracted.
